European Commission (2007). Reference Document on Best Available Techniques for the Manufacture of Large Volume Inorganic Chemicals - Ammonia, Acids and Fertilisers. Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control, August 2007. Seville: European IPPC Bureau (EIPPCB), Joint Research Centre.

Targeted pass of the 446-page BREF. Loaded (main file): ammonia energy by route (Table 2.6: conventional, advanced conventional, reduced primary, heat-exchange autothermal, partial oxidation; feed/fuel/net GJ(LHV)/t), process and combustion CO2 per t NH3, the 1100 t/d revamp (incremental capex), electrolytic ammonia (descriptive); nitric acid utilities by pressure type (Table 3.5) with typical unabated N2O (Table 3.7) and the EU average; N2O abatement: extended reactor chamber, secondary catalysts (general Kuiper costs plus five example plants from Table 3.12 with derived reduction %), tertiary combined De-N2O/De-NOx at AMI Linz (capex), NSCR (fuel opex, CO2 per t), emerging hydrocarbon De-N2O; urea energy by process (Tables 8.3-8.7, 8.16-8.17: conventional, CO2 stripping, NH3 stripping, ACES, IDR, revamp cases, new-plant specification, EU average); AN/CAN/ANS energy (Tables 9.3, 9.8); NPK drying/electricity/gas/steam (Table 7.3); sulphuric acid electricity and steam export; wet and thermal phosphoric acid; HF utilities. Not loaded: NOx/SO2/dust/fluoride/water emission tables and BAT-AELs (non-GHG), SCR costs (NOx only), SO2-abatement cost annex (Ch. 14), urea exhaust-gas treatment costs, catalyst replacement volumes, superphosphate detail (two totals in other-values). Efficiency techniques with a number are in _measures; primary-energy figures (Table 2.3), BAT energy and N2O levels, nitric acid energy export and hourly utilities are in _other-values. Locator convention: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 28). Most numbers are reprinted from EFMA, UBA, infoMil, IPCC or licensors and are flagged in notes. Traps: Table 2.6 shares rows between sources (only unambiguous feed/fuel/net pairings loaded); Table 8.6 mixes kWh rows (Austrian/German UBA) and MJ rows (infoMil) under one column - checked by 110 kWh = 396 MJ for the same configuration; Table 8.7 totals sometimes exclude CO2 compression electricity (stated in each note); Table 9.3 CAN/AN labels span rows. No price years printed; publication year 2007 used and flagged except where a year is printed (1999 USD, 1999 EUR project).

(1) No price year is printed for any cost; many costs are reprinted from 1997-2001 studies. (2) Table 2.6 (ammonia energy) has feed, fuel and net values from different sources on shared rows, so some pairings are ambiguous. (3) Table 8.6 (urea electricity) prints kWh and MJ rows under one unit column without row labels. (4) Several urea totals exclude CO2 compression electricity while others include it.
